title: UnCut FEM with PHT-splines on unfitted T-meshes
summary: We propose a novel unfitted finite element method based on polynomial splines over hierarchical T-meshes (PHT-splines) for elliptic partial differential equations (PDEs) posed on domains whose boundaries are described implicitly by a level-set function. Exploiting the enhanced smoothness of the spline space, we formulate the method by minimizing the $L^2$ residual of the PDE over an extended neighborhood of the physical domain.
